scope: Local native Anvil dump interrupted during shutdown; no application transaction fabricated
replacement: scripts/anvil-state.mjs atomic thirty-second snapshots; accounts, blocks, transactions and bounded 128-state history
limitations: Up to thirty seconds of writes can be lost in an abrupt engine crash
Historical EVM state is bounded to 128 recent blocks
additionalAttempts: Preserving 128 states took longer than one block interval; before/after identity checks correctly refused inconsistent snapshots.
Disabling automine alone does not disable interval mining in Anvil v1.5.1. The final writer pauses interval mining with anvil_setIntervalMining(0), then restores 3 seconds in finally.

Repeated Anvil loads accumulated multiple startup genesis headers in the hash-keyed block map. A strict deployment reuse check caught LOCAL_GENESIS_CHANGED. Snapshot output now selects canonical headers for duplicate heights, selecting genesis via block 1 parentHash, and filters associated orphan transaction entries. The identity guard remains unchanged.
